name: Saigou Daikuu
source:
Private Detective.
He has a passion for urban legends and conspiracy theories, constantly keeping up with the latest information and knowing just about every rumor circulating in Akihabara.
He admires the cool, hard-boiled secret agents seen in movies and manga, so both his speech and mannerisms are always theatrically dramatic.
His investigative skills are unquestionable, but because he believes in all kinds of urban legends and conspiracy theories, his explanations and deductions often become far more serious than they need to be.

[From in-game profile]
